purpose: Machine-readable roster and rule parameters for the fleet repository knowledge + agent-instruction standard, enforced by scripts/Check-RepoStandard.ps1. One authored agent contract (AGENTS.md) per repo; CLAUDE.md is an @-import adapter; docs/ holds durable curated knowledge; an upstream openwiki/ directory may hold derived notes (openwikiException); the tracker named per repo is the only backlog authority.

openwikiException.note: Upstream OpenWiki output and its scoped managed discovery blocks are permitted. This is not a general relaxation: no other generated tree is allowed, the wiki never replaces AGENTS.md or docs/, and it is written only by an explicit host-driven update.

docsExemptions.reason: The repository's AGENTS.md defines an exact ten-document flat docs layout (D-001); splitting those authoritative documents into taxonomy directories would duplicate knowledge.
